title: Sealed residency certificates for dedicated tenants (automated issuance & export)
creator: Anya Patel
description: Create an automated system that mints cryptographically sealed residency certificates for Dedicated tenants. Certificates should prove (1) which physical/region-bound nodes served the tenant during a snapshot window and (2) the tenant's retention policy settings at that time. Output must be exportable as a signed evidence package customers and auditors can verify independently.
acceptance_criteria: System issues a signed certificate bundle per tenant on-demand and on schedule (daily/weekly).

Each bundle includes: compact node attestations, hashed config (retention/residency settings), and a signed manifest with timestamps and signatures verifiable against Redwood's public verification key stored in KMS/HSM.
Bundles are exported to tenant-designated S3 (or SFTP) endpoints with integrity verification (signature + checksum).
API endpoints for customers to request historical bundles (by date range) and to fetch current tenant public verification info.
Automated test suite that validates signature verification, bundle integrity, and redaction rules for PII-sensitive metadata.
technical_design: Certificate composition: merkle root over per-node attestation blobs + hash of tenant config JSON (retain minimal fields: region, retention_days, encryption_kms_id, dedicated_pool_id).
Signing: use HSM-backed key (Cloud KMS with HSM or on-prem HSM for private deployments). Short-lived signing tokens for the exporter service; master key rotated quarterly.

Node attestations: lightweight JSON per serving node including node_id, region, gpus, start_ts, end_ts, runtime-hash; signed by node identity agent using node-local key provisioned by infra during boot.
Evidence package format: ZIP with manifest.json, node_attestations/*.json, config_hash.txt, signature.sig, and verification-instructions.txt.
Storage & export: signed bundles pushed to configured external endpoints. For hosted customers, bundles also stored in internal retention bucket with access controls for N days (configurable).
Verification: public verification endpoint returns current public key and sample verification script. Provide a CLI tool (redwood-residency-verify) for auditors.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): internal Dedicated tenants only. Enable daily bundle generation for 5 tenants and manual fetch via internal API. Monitor size, latency, and error rates.
Phase 2: opt-in beta for 10 pilot customers with export endpoints. Collect feedback on fields and frequency.
Phase 3: general availability for all Dedicated customers with per-tenant retention/rotation config in Console.
Rollback: if signing failures occur, fallback to a read-only evidence view and notify customers; do not publish unsigned bundles.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: HSM/KMS signing rate limits could block bulk issuance. Mitigation: queueing with backoff and per-tenant rate limits; request quota increase for KMS; batch-sign merkle roots where possible.
Risk: Leaking PII through attestations. Mitigation: strict redaction policy (no IPs, no user data), hashes only for sensitive fields, and security review with Privacy team.
Risk: Large bundle sizes for tenants with many nodes. Mitigation: compress attestation files, include summaries with option for full blob on-demand, and retention policy for internal storage.

Risk: Customers mistrust signature source. Mitigation: publish public verification keys and provide reproducible verification instructions; support customer-supplied verification endpoints for Private deploys.
